class.name: Projectile3D
class.brief_description: Manual-velocity projectile with swept collision: an Area3D that flies, steers, bounces, and reports hits.
class.description: Projectile3D is a deliberately non-rigid-body projectile: it owns its motion (velocity, gravity, homing) and uses a ShapeCast3D for continuous swept collision, so fast projectiles cannot tunnel through thin geometry. Call [method fire] to launch it; it processes itself each physics frame until it hits, expires, or [method stop] is called. Behavior flags: [member max_bounces] > 0 reflects off hits (scaled by [member bounce_factor]); [member homing] with a [member target] steers toward it; [member gravity_scale] > 0 applies engine gravity; [member max_lifetime] and [member max_range] bound flight. On hit it emits [signal hit] with the standard hit-data dictionary, and forwards the hit to a Hurtbox3D on the collider (or its children) via Hurtbox3D.apply_hit.

members.member: Array of StringName damage type tags.
Homing turn rate (lerp factor per second).
Bounces before destruction (0 = no bounce, destroy on first hit).
Flight time before expiry in seconds (0 = infinite).
Travel distance before expiry in units (0 = infinite).
Current velocity. Read it for hit data; set it for manual control.

method.name: fire
method.description: Starts the projectile at [param origin] traveling along [param direction] at [member speed]. Resets lifetime, range, and bounce state.

method.name: is_flying
method.description: True while the projectile is in flight.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops flight without destroying the node (script cleanup).

signal.name: expired
signal.description: Emitted when the projectile ends flight (hit with no bounces left, lifetime or range exceeded).

signal.name: hit
signal.description: Emitted on collision with the standard hit-data dictionary.
